subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` value shipped since January 20, 2026 through this doctor-managed migration?
rationale: The patch preserves prior effective behavior and avoids silently changing transport, but deliberately narrowing a released config contract and requiring operator repair is an upgrade-policy choice that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve HTTP-only retirement
options.body: Correct the lifecycle metadata and merge the current doctor migration, preserving stdout-only logs and requiring explicit operator choice before OTLP export resumes.

options.title: Retain gRPC acceptance
options.body: Keep the released config value accepted until real gRPC exporters or a different deprecation policy are ready.

recommendation.title: Approve HTTP-only retirement
recommendation.body: Correct the lifecycle metadata and merge the current doctor migration, preserving stdout-only logs and requiring explicit operator choice before OTLP export resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both the diagnostics exporter and the original released protocol contract.
